texts.value: May coordinate the cellular actions of activated EGF receptors and Ral-GTPases

Homodimer (Potential). Interacts with RAB11FIP2. Interacts with RALBP1, CRK and GRB2. Binding to RALBP1 does not affect its Ral-binding activity. Forms a complex with the SH3 domains of CRK and GRB2 which may link it to an EGF-responsive tyrosine kinase (By similarity). Interacts with AMPH, ITSN1 (via SH3 domains) and SGIP1; may be involved in clathrin-mediated endocytosis
Colocalize with ITSN1 at the plasma membrane in structures that are most probably clathrin-coated pits
Widely expressed with highest levels in heart and testis

disease.description: A neurodegenerative disorder associated with iron accumulation, primarily in the basal ganglia. Clinical features include speech and motor delay, truncal hypotonia, progressive cerebellar ataxia, and loss of ambulation. NBIA7 transmission pattern is consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance.

texts.value: The disease is caused by variants affecting the gene represented in this entry
